relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Kuraudo is staying at/connected to the Ayatsuji dojo; Moroboshi teases her as his woman, which she angrily denies.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Receives his call asking her to send Kuraudo to Kyushu.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Mentions the capital summons in the broader context of Ikki's peers, though Ikki is absent from the Tokyo scene.

periods.summary: Ayase is in the Ayatsuji dojo preparing for the capital defense summons when Moroboshi calls from Kyushu. He asks whether Kuraudo is with her and tells her to send him to Kyushu instead of the Tokyo front. Ayase protests that eastern Japan's student knights are under emergency summons, but Moroboshi argues that Kuraudo will be more useful in Kyushu and accepts responsibility for the breach. Her brief scene provides the contact route by which Kuraudo becomes the second arrow against Daien.

key_events.summary: Receives Moroboshi's call and becomes the channel for redirecting Kuraudo to Kyushu.
